[P2] Fall back to cleanup when executions appear during quiet verification

Both the `settle` CLI and `settle_previous()` construct a fresh `Cloud`, so `invoked_markers()` is empty. If the initial running list and worker snapshot are empty but an accepted callback execution becomes visible during `quiesce()`, this branch only waits; it never reaches discovery or calls `stop_durable_execution`. A recoverable abandoned execution can consequently exhaust the drain budget and fail settlement or the next deployment. Restore available invocation records and fall back to release/discovery/stop when work appears during this quiet window. Cover the fresh-process path with delayed service visibility.
